document.abstract: The SMPTE 2016 Annual Technical Conference and Exhibition (SMPTE 2016), 25–27 October in Hollywood, California, drew nearly 2500 registered attendees for a landmark event featuring 72 expert presentations and more than 108 exhibitors spread across two exhibit halls. This year’s event culminated with the SMPTE Centennial Gala, a celebration of the Society’s 100th birthday.
